$comment: Interface copy. Every label, heading, page title and screen-reader string the components use lives here, so the site can be reworded — or translated — without opening a .jsx file. {tokens} such as {clinic}, {city} and {established} are filled in automatically.

pages.$comment: Browser-tab titles and breadcrumb labels for each route.

notFound.title: This page has moved on.
notFound.body: The link is broken or the page was renamed. Head back to the homepage, or call the clinic and someone will point you to what you were looking for.

error.title: This page could not load.
error.body: The page hit an unexpected error. Try again — and if it keeps happening, call the clinic directly. The phone always works.

promise.title: Dentistry you can understand.
paragraphs: Nothing is treated until it has been explained. You see your own radiographs and intra-oral photographs on screen, you hear what is urgent and what can wait, and you leave with a written estimate that does not change halfway through.
That standard has held since {established}, across every patient we have treated — and it is the reason most of our new appointments come from someone we have already looked after.

hero.title: The hands behind your smile.
hero.intro: Every specialist here is board-certified and treats within their own discipline. You are never handed to a generalist for specialist work.

profile.contactText: Each dentist keeps their own line. If you already know who you need, skip the front desk.

aside.title: Talk to a dentist before you decide.
aside.text: No forms, no callbacks queued for tomorrow. Call the clinic and a dentist confirms whether this is the right treatment for you.
